quests.title: Basic Training - Basics
quests.details:
I am your esteemed
instructor. First, I shall
have you deliver some Raw
Meat. Slay a Popo in the
wild, and deliver the meat
to the Delivery Box in camp.
Good luck.

quests.title: Basic Training - BBQ
quests.details:
Your esteemed instructor
once again. Now we will
cover BBQ training. Carve
Raw Meat from a Popo and
then use the BBQ Spit to
cook a tasty steak. It's my
dinner, so don't burn it!

quests.title: Basic Training - Gathering
quests.details:
Another lesson from your
esteemed instructor. Today
you will train in gathering
Honey. Snowy mountain Honey
is less sweet but more
fragrant than regular honey.
A real treat with manly men!

quests.title: Basic Training - Combining
quests.details:
Take some advice from your
esteemed instructor, if
there is one thing a hunter
cannot go without, it is
a Potion. Drink it when
injured and all will be
well. Never forget this!

quests.title: Basic Training - Fishing
quests.details:
Once again you come before
your esteemed instructor.
Your next quest is to
deliver a Sushifish. Use
bait near the waterside and
catch a big one. Just
deliver it before dinner!

quests.title: Basic Training - Transport
quests.details:
I am truly esteemed,
especially as an instructor.
Today's quest is to snatch a
Carnivore Egg and return it
to camp. This may be
training, but it is no
opportunity to slack!

quests.title: Basic Training - Hunting
quests.details:
You will hold me in great
esteem as I say this is the
last basic training quest.
You must hunt down the
fierce Giadrome. Stare death
in the face and show your
true hunting spirit.

quests.title: Sword Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Sword mastery is the
jumping attack. Gauge the
distance of the jump and
then unleash a string of
deadly attacks!

quests.title: Dual Blade Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Dual Blade mastery is
the timing of Demonization.
Don't wait for a chance to
Demonize, Demonize and
create your own chances.

quests.title: Great Sword Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Great Sword mastery
is using ready attacks and
charge slices. View your
enemy and decide if a quick
cut or strong slice is best.

quests.title: Long Sword Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Long Sword mastery
lies in the Spirit gauge. If
you can fill the gauge, your
attack power will increase
greatly! Fill it up!

quests.title: Hammer Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Hammer mastery is the
charge attack. An attack
should be charged to the
right level then released.
Time the hit with your soul!

quests.title: Hunting Horn Mastery
quests.details:
I, your instructor, must
inform you that the key to
Horn mastery is in the
Recital. String together 2
white notes to make yourself
strong, then claim victory
before the effect wears off.

quests.title: Lance Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Lance mastery is
guarding. Use the Lance to
block an approaching
monster's attack then
counter fiercely!

quests.title: Gunlance Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the 
key to Gunlance mastery is
bombardment. Blast armored
monsters into submission,
then take that chance to
unleash Wyvern's Fire!

quests.title: Light Bowgun Mastery
quests.details:
Esteemed instructor here,
remember the key to the
Light Bowgun is ammo
selection. Select your ammo
depending on the monster and
situation. Master the
qualities of each shot!

quests.title: Heavy Bowgun Mastery
quests.details:
Your esteemed instructor
reminds you that the key to
the Heavy Bowgun is judging
the proper distance. A
Bowgun's advantages aren't
limited to long distances,
so pick the right distance!

quests.title: Bow Mastery
quests.details:
Your esteemed instructor
reminds you that the key to
Bow mastery is charging.
Charge the power of the Bow
and then release it at the
perfect moment. Charged
arrows are a unique beast!

quests.title: Yian Kut-Ku Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Yian Kut-Ku. Its
weakness is its sensitivity
to loud noises. Try a Sonic
Bomb or even a Barrel-Bomb!

quests.title: Congalala Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Congalala. If you
are hit by something it has
thrown, the smell will spoil
your items and you won't be
able to use them!

quests.title: Khezu Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Khezu. You must
fear not only its electric
attacks but also its roar.
Thus, equip a weapon guard
and be ready to use it.

quests.title: Daimyo Hermitaur Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Daimyo Hermitaur.
Supposedly you can only
crack its shell with a
Hammer or Hunting Horn, but
a Lance works as well!

quests.title: Blangonga Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Blangonga. You may
even become a Snowman!
The best escape is using a
Thawing Agent... Or hitting
the beast on its arms!

quests.title: Yian Garuga Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Yian Garuga. After
threatening you, Garuga
likes to let off a roar or
two. When you sense a
threat, prepare yourself!

quests.title: Tigrex Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Tigrex. Tigrex will
come after you with all its
got, so don't just wait
around. Jump into the fight!

quests.title: Diablos Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Diablos. When it's
on the defensive, a Sonic
Bomb is useful, but once
it's mad, that won't do a
thing, so use a Flash Bomb!

quests.title: Gravios Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Gravios. When
fighting underneath it,
beware of being crushed!
When it's airborne, choose
your spots! Don't mess up!

quests.title: Kirin Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Today you will
battle a Kirin. The key to
this battle is lightning. If
you can detect its patterns,
you can increase your
chances of victory!

quests.title: Cephadrome Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Time to face a
Cephadrome! Aim to use Small
Barrel-Bombs when it is
hiding. Set the bomb where
it will resurface! That's
the secret!

quests.title: Plesioth Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Time to face a
Plesioth! Chasing it when it
changes areas is easy, but
you'll have to figure out a
way to fish it out of the
ground.

quests.title: Shogun Ceanataur Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Time to face a
Shogun Ceanataur! If it
extends its claws, that's
your cue to pay attention
because its reach has
doubled! Get out of the way!

quests.title: Rathalos Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Time to face a
Rathalos! You'll need a
Paintball to keep track of
it when it takes to flight,
so make sure you hit it
before it gets away!

quests.title: Rajang Training
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. So you've made
it this far, huh!? I'm
speechless! Let's see what
you've got! Show me your
true strength on this 
mountain!

quests.title: Blue Yian Kut-Ku Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. If you can clear
this Group Training in time,
your reward will explode!
Faster! Smarter! Set a new
record!

quests.title: Cephadrome Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. An all out
assault will only lower your
time marginally. Victory
rests on what you have and
what you can combine it with
in the southern desert.

quests.title: Rathian Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. No time for
tricks, just use your skills
and finish this beast off!
Use everything you've
learned about "cooperation"
and obliterate your foe!

quests.title: Congalala Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. I want to see
your true power on this one!
Give it all you've got, you
hear!? But don't leave your
friends in the dust. Be as
one! Fight as one!

quests.title: Shogun Ceanataur Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. Your opponent
this time is a pair of
Shogun Ceanataurs. You only
have to beat one to clear
the quest, so remember which
one you're going after!

quests.title: Tigrex Exercises
quests.details:
It is I, your esteemed
instructor. You'll be going
after 2 Tigrex back to
back today. Try not to
attack when it's infuriated,
and use whatever you've got
to create an opening!
